import cv2, numpy as np, json, math, subprocess
subprocess.run(['python3', '/work/compute_poses.py'])
poses = json.load(open('/work/poses.json'))
pose = poses['54']
print('Pose 54:', pose)

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0054.png')
# sofa color is blue/gray: B > 100, G ~ 100-120, R ~ 100-120
# Find bottom of sofa
sofa_mask = (img[:, :, 0] > 90) & (img[:, :, 0] < 140) & (img[:, :, 1] > 80) & (img[:, :, 1] < 120) & (img[:, :, 2] > 70) & (img[:, :, 2] < 110)
ys, xs = np.where(sofa_mask)
print(f'Sofa: u min={xs.min()}, max={xs.max()}, mean={xs.mean():.1f}')
print(f'Sofa: v min={ys.min()}, max={ys.max()}')

# Bottom contact vertices
# Let's inspect along bottom edges
# Left corner and right corner
v_bot = ys.max()
u_c = xs.mean()

z_cam = 256.0 * 1.55 / (v_bot - 255.5)
x_cam = (u_c - 255.5) / 256.0 * z_cam
h_rad = math.radians(pose['h'])
xw = pose['x'] + x_cam * math.cos(h_rad) + z_cam * math.sin(h_rad)
yw = pose['y'] - x_cam * math.sin(h_rad) + z_cam * math.cos(h_rad)
print(f'Sofa from obs_0054: xw={xw:.3f}, yw={yw:.3f}')
"
